positions.text: Tax relief for homeowners and renters

bruce-a-blakeman.quote: As Governor, he will deliver real relief to homeowners and renters - just as he did as County Executive.
bruce-a-blakeman.realWorldImpact: Expect proposals aimed at lowering property-related costs for homeowners and renters. As County Executive he held county property taxes flat, according to his campaign.

positions.text: Returning money to New Yorkers through state refunds and credits

kathy-c-hochul.quote: As Governor, Kathy has taken decisive action to put money back in people’s pockets, lower costs, and invest in keeping New Yorkers safe.
kathy-c-hochul.realWorldImpact: Expect a continued focus on state rebates, refunds and credits aimed at household costs. Specific new measures would depend on the budget the Legislature passes.

kathy-c-hochul.quote: She sent inflation refund checks to over 8 million New Yorkers, secured universal free school meals for all students, tripled the child tax credit, made historic middle-class tax cuts, banned cell phones during school hours, and enacted landmark gun safety legislation.
kathy-c-hochul.realWorldImpact: Middle-income families and parents would likely keep the lower state tax rates and larger child credit already in place. Whether they grow further depends on future state budgets.

positions.text: Local law enforcement working with ICE

bruce-a-blakeman.quote: Blakeman said NO to Kathy Hochul’s sanctuary policies, and worked with ICE to take criminals off our streets.
bruce-a-blakeman.realWorldImpact: State and local police would likely cooperate more closely with federal immigration enforcement. Limits on that cooperation under current state policy could be rolled back.

kathy-c-hochul.realWorldImpact: State policy would likely keep limits on how state and local agencies cooperate with federal immigration enforcement. The campaign site doesn't spell out specific new measures.

issues.name: Abortion
issues.description: Access to and limits on abortion.

positions.text: Legal protections for abortion access in New York

kathy-c-hochul.quote: Protected abortion rights in New York
kathy-c-hochul.realWorldImpact: Abortion would likely remain legally available in New York under existing state protections. State policy would be unlikely to add new restrictions.

issues.name: Crime
issues.description: Crime, policing and public safety.

positions.text: A strict approach to enforcing laws against crime

bruce-a-blakeman.quote: Blakeman has a no-nonsense approach to fighting crime.
bruce-a-blakeman.realWorldImpact: Expect an emphasis on police staffing and enforcement. His campaign points to hiring more than 900 police and law enforcement officers as County Executive.

kathy-c-hochul.quote: She is fighting to lower costs, invest in public safety, and stand up to Trump.
kathy-c-hochul.realWorldImpact: State funding for public safety programs would likely continue at current or higher levels. The campaign site doesn't detail which programs.
